# pgs_account (Resource)

A pgs account: a user name, its SSH public keys and (optionally) the feature flag that allows uploading. The admin account (holder of the `admin` feature flag) can never be managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An account with two keys and a 5 GB quota.
resource "pgs_account" "projectx" {
  name = "projectx"

  public_keys = [
    { key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAA... alice@laptop", description = "alice" },
    { key = file("${path.module}/bob.pub"), description = "bob (CI)" },
  ]

  access = {
    storage_max = 5000000000
  }
}

# The simplest account: one key, default quotas. The description defaults to the key's comment.
resource "pgs_account" "simple" {
  name = "simple"

  public_keys = [
    { key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAA... carol@desktop" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Account name. Lowercase letters and digits only: pgs serves sites at `<account>-<project>.<domain>` and splits on the first `-`. Renaming changes the URLs of all the account's sites.
- `public_keys` (Attributes Set) SSH public keys that log in as this account. At least one is required. A key can belong to one account only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--public_keys))

### Optional

- `access` (Attributes) Metadata of the account's `pgs` feature flag. The flag itself always exists (without it the account would have no access to pgs); this block only sets its expiry and quotas. Omit it, or leave attributes unset, for the defaults. Other flags of the account are never touched. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access))
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Delete the account even if it still has projects. Site files in pgs's object storage are not removed.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp as stored by pgs.
- `flag_id` (String) Id of the account's `pgs` row in feature_flags (null while the row is missing; the plan then shows the `access` drift and apply recreates it).
- `id` (String) The numeric id of the account in pgs's app_users table.

<a id="nestedatt--public_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `public_keys`

Required:

- `key` (String) Public key in authorized_keys format (a trailing comment is allowed and ignored for matching).

Optional:

- `description` (String) Free-text description (pgs's `public_keys.name`, shown as the login identity), e.g. which person uses the key. Defaults to the key's comment, or `main` when it has none.


<a id="nestedatt--access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access`

Optional:

- `expires_at` (String) Expiry as `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC), stored verbatim. Default `2200-01-01`.
- `file_max` (Number) Maximum size of one file in bytes. Unset: pgs default (10 MB).
- `special_file_max` (Number) Maximum size of `_headers`, `_redirects` and `_pgs_ignore` in bytes. Unset: pgs default (5 KB).
- `storage_max` (Number) Total storage quota in bytes. Unset: pgs default (50 MB).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing account by its name.
tofu import pgs_account.projectx projectx
```
